fields.description: Native Grading Scale this version governs through. Links only; threshold values arrive with owner decision D1 and are never invented here.
fields.label: Grading scale

fields.description: Owned assessment components as canonical JSON, written only by the guarded facet commands. Empty until the Course Owner defines them; native per-group Assessment Plans are scheduled instances and are never referenced here.
fields.label: Components

fields.description: Owned component weights as canonical JSON. Native Course weight columns are never read; combination semantics arrive with a future owner rule.
fields.label: Weights

fields.description: Owned pass and cutoff rules as canonical JSON. No native pass or fail concept exists; every cutoff is owner-entered.
fields.label: Pass rules

fields.description: Owned rubric requirements as canonical JSON: required evidence and rating levels per rubric. Score conversion is a future owner rule.
fields.label: Rubrics

fields.description: Owned progression rules as canonical JSON: required evidence and the target level. A progression decision never enrolls by itself.
fields.label: Progression

fields.description: Owned retake rules as canonical JSON: attempts, waits, scope and which attempt governs. Prior attempts are always preserved.
fields.label: Retakes

fields.description: Owned level mapping as canonical JSON: the level codes this policy version governs. Empty governs nothing.
fields.label: Level mapping

fields.description: Why this version was set. Mandatory on every version write.
fields.label: Reason

fields.description: Closed date: the day this version stopped governing new activity. Written once when a newer version supersedes it; the row itself is never rewritten.
fields.label: Superseded on
